```{=html}
<script>
(function loadGSAP() {
  var savedDefine = window.define;
  window.define = undefined;
  var s1 = document.createElement('script');
  s1.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js';
  s1.onload = function() {
    window.define = savedDefine;
    document.dispatchEvent(new Event('gsap-ready'));
  };
  s1.onerror = function() {
    window.define = savedDefine;
    document.dispatchEvent(new Event('gsap-ready'));
  };
  document.head.appendChild(s1);
})();
</script>

<!-- Preload only the first video. Posters were removed from the video tags to
     avoid flashing stale cached PNGs; the subsequent videos are prefetched by
     JS as the user lands on each scene. -->
<link rel="preload" as="video" href="../assets/my-story-beat-00-intro.mp4" type="video/mp4">

<div class="gs-theater" id="gs-theater">
  <a href="/" class="gs-back-link" aria-label="Back to home">
    <span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">&larr;</span>
    <span>merna.org</span>
  </a>
  <div class="gs-screen" id="gs-screen">
    <div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:#5a5a5a;font-style:italic;">Loading story...</div>
  </div>
  <div class="gs-timeline-bar">
    <div class="gs-timeline-fill" id="gs-tl-fill"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="gs-nav-controls">
    <button class="gs-nav-btn gs-nav-prev" id="gs-prev" disabled>Previous</button>
    <span class="gs-nav-counter" id="gs-counter">1 / 13</span>
    <button class="gs-nav-btn gs-nav-next" id="gs-next">Next</button>
  </div>
  <div class="gs-nav-restart"><button class="gs-restart-btn" id="gs-restart">Restart</button></div>
</div>

<script>
function initAboutTheater() {
  var hasGsap = typeof gsap !== 'undefined';
  var screen = document.getElementById('gs-screen');
  var tlFill = document.getElementById('gs-tl-fill');
  var prevBtn = document.getElementById('gs-prev');
  var nextBtn = document.getElementById('gs-next');
  var counterEl = document.getElementById('gs-counter');
  var restartBtn = document.getElementById('gs-restart');
  var currentScene = 0;

  function clearScreen() {
    if (hasGsap) gsap.killTweensOf(screen.querySelectorAll('*'));
    screen.innerHTML = '';
    screen.style.opacity = 1;
  }

  // Mount a new scene as its own absolutely-positioned layer over the previous
  // one. The new layer stays at opacity 0 until its video actually starts
  // playing (or 1.8s elapses as a safety net), then we cross-fade. This is
  // what makes scene changes feel like a smooth dissolve instead of a wipe
  // -> blank -> poster -> video stutter.
  function mountScene(htmlString, setupFn) {
    var old = screen.querySelector('.scene-layer');

    if (old && hasGsap) {
      gsap.to(old, {
        opacity: 0,
        duration: 0.35,
        ease: 'power2.in',
        onComplete: function() {
          if (hasGsap) gsap.killTweensOf(old.querySelectorAll('*'));
          if (old.parentNode) old.parentNode.removeChild(old);
        }
      });
    } else if (old && old.parentNode) {
      old.parentNode.removeChild(old);
    }

    var layer = document.createElement('div');
    layer.className = 'scene-layer';
    layer.innerHTML = htmlString;
    layer.style.opacity = '0';
    screen.appendChild(layer);

    if (setupFn) setupFn(layer);

    function fadeInNew() {
      if (hasGsap) {
        gsap.to(layer, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out' });
      } else {
        layer.style.opacity = '1';
      }
    }

    var vid = layer.querySelector('video');
    if (vid) {
      var fired = false;
      function reveal() { if (fired) return; fired = true; fadeInNew(); }
      vid.addEventListener('playing', reveal, { once: true });
      vid.addEventListener('loadeddata', reveal, { once: true });
      var pp = vid.play();
      if (pp && pp.catch) pp.catch(function(){});
      setTimeout(reveal, 1800);
    } else {
      fadeInNew();
    }
  }

  function makeScene(imgSrc, noteText) {
    var webpSrc = imgSrc.replace('.png', '.webp');
    return function() {
      var html =
        '<div class="gs-about-scene">' +
          '<div class="gs-about-image"><picture>' +
            '<source srcset="' + webpSrc + '" type="image/webp">' +
            '<img src="' + imgSrc + '" alt="" loading="lazy" />' +
          '</picture></div>' +
          '<div class="gs-about-note"><div class="gs-bubble" style="text-align:left !important;"><p>' + noteText + '</p></div></div>' +
        '</div>';
      mountScene(html, function(layer) {
        if (hasGsap) {
          gsap.fromTo(layer.querySelector('.gs-about-image'),
            { x: -20, opacity: 0 }, { x: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out' });
          gsap.fromTo(layer.querySelector('.gs-about-note'),
            { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out', delay: 0.15 });
        }
      });
    };
  }

  // Full-bleed video beat with a per-letter Caveat highlighter caption.
  // The caption stays hidden until the video actually starts playing so the
  // type-on never runs against a blank or poster frame.
  function makeVideoBeat(videoSrc, posterSrc, captionText) {
    return function() {
      var captionLetters = '';
      var words = captionText.split(' ');
      for (var w = 0; w < words.length; w++) {
        captionLetters += '<span class="cap-word">';
        for (var c = 0; c < words[w].length; c++) {
          var ch = words[w].charAt(c);
          captionLetters += '<span class="cap-letter">' + ch.replace('<', '&lt;').replace('>', '&gt;') + '</span>';
        }
        captionLetters += '</span>';
        if (w < words.length - 1) {
          captionLetters += '<span class="cap-letter cap-space">&nbsp;</span>';
        }
      }
      var html =
        '<div class="gs-intro-fullscreen">' +
          '<video class="gs-intro-video" src="' + videoSrc + '" autoplay loop muted playsinline preload="auto"></video>' +
          '<div class="story-beat-caption"><span class="story-beat-caption-inner">' + captionLetters + '</span></div>' +
        '</div>';

      mountScene(html, function(layer) {
        var vid = layer.querySelector('video.gs-intro-video');
        var letters = layer.querySelectorAll('.story-beat-caption .cap-letter');
        var captionStarted = false;

        if (hasGsap && letters.length) {
          gsap.set(letters, { opacity: 0, y: 4 });
        }

        function startCaption() {
          if (captionStarted || !letters.length) return;
          captionStarted = true;
          if (hasGsap) {
            gsap.to(letters, {
              opacity: 1,
              y: 0,
              duration: 0.18,
              ease: 'power1.out',
              stagger: 0.05,
              delay: 0.2
            });
          } else {
            for (var li = 0; li < letters.length; li++) {
              (function(el, idx){
                setTimeout(function(){ el.style.opacity = 1; }, 200 + idx * 50);
              })(letters[li], li);
            }
          }
        }

        if (vid) {
          vid.addEventListener('playing', startCaption, { once: true });
          vid.addEventListener('loadeddata', startCaption, { once: true });
          setTimeout(startCaption, 2500);
        } else {
          startCaption();
        }
      });
    };
  }

  var scenes = [
    function() {
      var html =
        '<div class="gs-intro-fullscreen">' +
          '<video class="gs-intro-video" src="../assets/my-story-beat-00-intro.mp4" autoplay loop muted playsinline preload="auto"></video>' +
          '<div class="gs-intro-vignette"></div>' +
          '<div class="gs-intro-text-wrap">' +
            '<p class="gs-intro-text"></p>' +
            '<span class="gs-intro-cursor"></span>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';

      mountScene(html, function(layer) {
        var vid = layer.querySelector('video.gs-intro-video');
        var textEl = layer.querySelector('.gs-intro-text');
        var cursorEl = layer.querySelector('.gs-intro-cursor');

        var fullText = "Hi, I'm Merna. Welcome to my story. Click next to walk through how I got here.";
        if (window.__introTypeTimer) { clearTimeout(window.__introTypeTimer); }
        var i = 0;
        var typingStarted = false;
        function type() {
          if (!textEl || !textEl.isConnected) return;
          if (i < fullText.length) {
            textEl.textContent += fullText.charAt(i);
            i++;
            var ch = fullText.charAt(i - 1);
            var delay = (ch === '.' || ch === ',') ? 220 : 38;
            window.__introTypeTimer = setTimeout(type, delay);
          } else if (cursorEl) {
            cursorEl.classList.add('done');
          }
        }
        function startTyping() {
          if (typingStarted) return;
          typingStarted = true;
          window.__introTypeTimer = setTimeout(type, 250);
        }

        if (vid) {
          vid.addEventListener('playing', startTyping, { once: true });
          vid.addEventListener('loadeddata', startTyping, { once: true });
          setTimeout(startTyping, 2500);
        } else {
          startTyping();
        }

        if (hasGsap) {
          gsap.fromTo(layer.querySelector('.gs-intro-text-wrap'),
            { y: 14, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power2.out', delay: 0.35 });
        }
      });
    },
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-01-cairo.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-01-cairo.png',
      "My story starts in Cairo. The city I was born in, grew up in, and still carry with me everywhere I go."),
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-02-auc.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-02-auc.png',
      "I graduated from the American University in Cairo in 2014, with dual degrees in Architectural Engineering and Finance. Buildings taught me systems, finance taught me numbers. The combination became my way of seeing the world."),
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-03-corplease-early.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-03-corplease-early.png',
      "My first job was at Corplease, Egypt's largest leasing company. Four quiet years of learning the craft, building expertise one credit file at a time."),
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-04-corplease-manager.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-04-corplease-manager.png',
      "In 2018 I became Manager, leading a team of six analysts. This is where I taught myself Python and built automated pipelines that cut our credit assessment time by forty percent. A finance team running on code was rare in Egypt then. I was hooked."),
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-05-banque-misr.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-05-banque-misr.png',
      "From 2020 to 2023 I served as Senior Vice President of Strategic Ventures at Banque Misr, Egypt's second largest national bank. I led sector analysis across fifteen plus industries with McKinsey and BCG as strategy partners, uncovered a hundred billion in export potential, and presented to cabinet ministers. Peak finance. And yet I knew I wanted more."),
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-06-ucsd.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-06-ucsd.png',
      "In 2025 I started the MSBA program at the University of California San Diego, Rady School of Management. STEM designated. Business meets machine learning. I traded a Senior VP title for a student ID, and it was the best decision I have made."),
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-07-toolkit.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-07-toolkit.png',
      "Today my toolkit is Python, SQL, Tableau, XGBoost, NLP, regression, classification, and everything in between. Every tool earned on a real project."),
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-08-biking.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-08-biking.png',
      "When I need to think, I ride. Road biking along the California coast, Pacific on one side, Torrey Pines on the other. Somewhere between mile ten and mile twenty, every problem unknots itself."),
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-09-barca.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-09-barca.png',
      "I am forever blaugrana. Watching Barça play is watching teamwork and strategy at the highest level. Every match is a masterclass. Visca Barça."),
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-10-travel.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-10-travel.png',
      "I have been lucky to see a lot of the world. Fifty plus cities across Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and North America. Hiking, camping, skiing, exploring. The best moments always happen off the tourist trail."),
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-11-sourdough.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-11-sourdough.png',
      "I bake sourdough. It turns out fermentation, hydration math, and patient precision are the same skills I use in data analytics. The analyst bakes bread."),
    makeVideoBeat('../assets/my-story-beat-12-future.mp4', '../assets/my-story-beat-12-future.png',
      "That is my story so far. Now let us talk about what comes next. Sales operations, marketing analytics, business intelligence, anywhere systems thinking meets quantitative rigor. I am open to opportunity and excited about what we might build together.")
  ];

  // Each scene's video URL, indexed by scene number. Used to prefetch
  // the next scene's video so the click-Next transition feels instant.
  var sceneVideoUrls = [
    '../assets/my-story-beat-00-intro.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-01-cairo.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-02-auc.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-03-corplease-early.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-04-corplease-manager.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-05-banque-misr.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-06-ucsd.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-07-toolkit.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-08-biking.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-09-barca.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-10-travel.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-11-sourdough.mp4',
    '../assets/my-story-beat-12-future.mp4'
  ];
  var prefetched = {};
  function prefetchVideo(url) {
    if (!url || prefetched[url]) return;
    prefetched[url] = true;
    var link = document.createElement('link');
    link.rel = 'prefetch';
    link.as = 'video';
    link.href = url;
    link.type = 'video/mp4';
    document.head.appendChild(link);
  }

  function goTo(n) {
    if (n < 0 || n >= scenes.length) return;
    currentScene = n;
    scenes[n]();
    tlFill.style.width = ((n + 1) / scenes.length * 100) + '%';
    counterEl.textContent = (n + 1) + ' / ' + scenes.length;
    prevBtn.disabled = (n === 0);
    nextBtn.disabled = (n === scenes.length - 1);
    // Warm the cache for the next two video scenes so transitions feel snappy
    prefetchVideo(sceneVideoUrls[n + 1]);
    prefetchVideo(sceneVideoUrls[n + 2]);
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { goTo(currentScene - 1); });
  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { goTo(currentScene + 1); });
  restartBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { goTo(0); });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    var rect = document.getElementById('gs-theater').getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.top > window.innerHeight || rect.bottom < 0) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { goTo(currentScene + 1); e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { goTo(currentScene - 1); e.preventDefault(); }
  });

  goTo(0);
}
if (typeof gsap !== 'undefined') { initAboutTheater(); }
else { document.addEventListener('gsap-ready', initAboutTheater); }
</script>

<div style="text-align:center;padding:2rem 0 1rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(44,62,80,0.08);margin-top:1rem;">
  <div style="display:flex;gap:1rem;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">

    <a href="https://github.com/merna-saad" class="about-link-btn" style="font-size:0.8rem;padding:6px 18px;">GitHub</a>
  </div>
</div>
```
